name: Yuunagi-sou no S-kyuu no Kanojo-tachi 2
original_name: 夕凪荘のＳ級の彼女たち 2
source:
For a long time, the [b]2nd floor[/b] of [b]Yuunagi-sou[/b] had been vacant.

This peculiar apartment is reserved for privileged S-class individuals, so a few empty rooms were no surprise.

However――.

✦ ∞ ✦ ∞ ✦

As if drawn to our protagonist, [b]new tenants[/b] begin to arrive one after another.

An annoying [b]former [i]kouhai[/i][/b].
An overly anxious [b]school teacher[/b].
A studious-looking closet pervert [b]examinee[/b].
An easily aroused aspiring [b][i]seiyuu[/i][/b].

✦ ∞ ✦ ∞ ✦

Thus, the entire 2nd floor is occupied, and Yuunagi-sou is getting livelier. 
With the 2nd floor as the backdrop, [b]a pure~lewd life[/b] begins once again......❤️️

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.moon-stone.jp/product2/msc04/#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
长期以来，[b]汤凪庄[/b]的[b]二楼[/b]一直空置。

这间奇特的公寓是为S级特权人士保留的，所以有几个空房间也就不足为奇了。

然而 -。

✦ 无穷大 ✦ 无穷大 ✦

仿佛被我们的主角所吸引，[b]新租户[/b]开始陆续到来。

一个烦人的[b]前[i]kouhai[/i][/b]。
过度焦虑的[b]学校老师[/b]。
一个看起来勤奋好学的柜内变态[b]考生[/b]。
一个容易被激发的有抱负的[b][i]声优[/i][/b]。

✦ 无穷大 ✦ 无穷大 ✦

这样一来，整个二楼都被占领了，汤凪庄变得更加热闹。
以二楼为背景，[b]清纯~淫荡的生活[/b]再次开始……❤️️

[翻译编辑自[url=https://www.moon-stone.jp/product2/msc04/#story]官网[/url]]
